title: Rabbi Natan Barabbi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot cites this name from Sifrei, Va'etchanan, disputing with Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai. Hyman states that Sifrei actually has בר״בי, an abbreviation for bar Yosef, and identifies the figure as Rabbi Yonatan bar Yosef.

notes.text: Hyman gives an abbreviation explanation, not a transposition-of-letters theory. The supplied heading and proposed Yonatan bar Yosef reading remain separate.

The consulted Sifrei Devarim 32:12 reads Rabbi Natan berabbi Yosef, followed in 32:13 by Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai on chastisements. Thus it supplies the name and adjacent Shimon context, but it does not print Hyman’s proposed Yonatan. His abbreviation explanation and identification are retained as his claims, not silently substituted for the consulted reading or admitted as an identity equation.
